why: The final review (W4-01, W4-02) changed two acceptance rules. Stored results were re-adjudicated under them; the stored run folders are unchanged.

fixed_build_conflict.rule: A reproduction that the fixed build also shows is not a reproduction (status fixed_build_conflict, issue status attempted_miss).
fixed_build_conflict.method: Every stored replay.json (132) was read for fixed_build_shows_failure.
fixed_build_conflict.unchanged: No census or held-out row: those issues have no fixed build, so the check never ran for them.

state_seeding_tests.rule: A generated test that sets the failing state through the target's test API, instead of reaching it through input, is refused.
state_seeding_tests.method: The nine verified 9852 tests stored before the repair (runs 9 and 12 to 19) were read by the repair author.

set_state_through_the_test_api.how: calls API.setAppState with the line in progress and a text element being edited
falls back to API.setAppState when the two clicks leave no line in progress

state_seeding_tests.note: Runs 12 and 18 were recorded as proof_verified. Under the repaired rule their tests would not have run. The stored core-proof records predate the rule and carry no input rule, so checkCoreProof still reads them as consistent.

missed.22: Watch chose a condition the page cannot read

after_repair.kept_tests: All six were read: each uses only keyboard, pointer and toolbar input.
